name: kenspc
description: Structured software development workflows for Claude Code, aligned with Claude 5 generation guidance (last reviewed 2026-09-25): effort follows the session, with three xhigh overrides (unattended implementation and fixing, multi-round planning). Skills cover brief generation, plan generation, task decomposition, bug diagnosis, automated batch implementation, multi-angle parallel review, and project guide generation; eleven reusable subagents do the review, fix, verification, and implementation work. v3 follows six design rules: workflow SOP stays, business rules framed as why-not-command, DONE-criteria over step-by-step flow, no anti-rationalization scaffolding, plain language over MUST/NEVER/CRITICAL/ULTRATHINK, and review rubrics with named failure modes over generic checklists.
